name: Apothecary Johaan
summary: Apothecary Johaan is an alchemist and researcher of the Royal Apothecary Society stationed in Brill. Tasked by his order and Lady Sylvanas, he conducts lethal experiments on local flora and fauna to develop the Forsaken's new plague.

sections.title: A Servant of the Society
sections.body: Working openly out of the Forsaken settlement of Brill in Tirisfal Glades, Apothecary Johaan represents the scientific ambitions of the newly formed Royal Apothecary Society. Like his colleagues across Lordaeron, Johaan operates under direct orders to craft biological and alchemical weapons capable of securing the Forsaken's fragile future against the living and the Scourge alike.

sections.title: Brewing the New Plague
sections.body: Johaan coordinates early field trials for what the Society calls the 'New Plague'. Using raw materials harvested from Tirisfal's corrupted wildlife and agricultural blights—such as darkhound blood, murloc scales, spider venom and stolen farm pumpkins—he tests toxin mixtures and evaluates their potency on living subjects before dispatching results down south to Silverpine Forest.

faq.answer: Apothecary Johaan is an alchemical researcher stationed in Brill. He belongs to the Royal Apothecary Society and directs young Forsaken champions to gather vile reagents across Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Where can I find Apothecary Johaan?
faq.answer: He can be found standing outside near the gallows and alchemical apparatus in the town of Brill, just north of the Undercity in Tirisfal Glades.
Johaan is formulating and refining early strains of the New Plague, testing biological agents and venomous extracts from Tirisfal's blighted fields and beasts.

faq.q: What does he do with the plague samples?
faq.answer: Once test mixtures are concocted and their lethality assessed, Johaan packages the samples and sends couriers to deliver them to allied apothecaries stationed in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: What organization does Johaan belong to?
faq.answer: He is an active member of the Royal Apothecary Society, the alchemical guild serving Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and the Forsaken in the Undercity.

faq.q: Why is he interested in the local farms?
faq.answer: Human farms like the Solliden Farmstead and the nearby pumpkin patches grow pumpkins that provide raw reagents for his experimental toxins.

angles.text: Johaan's research is central to the Forsaken cause, developing the very weapons needed to carve out a permanent homeland free of Scourge and living threats.
While orcs and tauren might balk at alchemical blights, Johaan's deadly concoctions serve the strategic security of the Horde's foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms.
